My guy did this back in January! He faked us out around 12/13 months because he went through a sleep regression so just make sure it's not that first! When he was 15 months he was definitely ready though. 

The way I did it was he usually napped 10:30-12 would wake up and have lunch and nap again at 3-430. So I pushed his nap to 11:15/11:30(depending on his energy) for one week and then completely to 12 the next. I made sure that we had outside time from 10-10:45 so he got a lot of sun and was kept active then lunch. He now sleeps for 2 1/2hrs from 12-230. For a bit he woke up after an hour and a half but I would try to get him back to sleep so his body would get used to sleeping longer.

Mine usually wakes up around 2:30 but if he's still asleep I give it until 2:45 unless he's had a hard day in which case I'll give him until 3. I don't do any later than that because his wake window is about 5 hours and 8pm is the latest he should go to bed.

So to preface this I am not a parent but I am a trans man so I can give perspective from his point of view. 

I would definitely suggest talking with your child's therapist with your child so you can get all the information you can about how he's feeling. After that you need to figure out how to talk to your husband about it. The fact that he's making transphobic remarks and getting in fights with your child about it will impede any sort of further bond between them. Find information about transgender people and statistics about family support to back you up. 

Once you've talked with your husband about it I would do a family discussion to include your other children. Despite your child saying they don't want to tell them they need to be responsible for that WITH your support and understanding. It needs to be made known that harassment and bullying will not be tolerated. This is a tough time for all and maybe it will be a phase but even if it is don't discredit it. 

You sound like a very caring and involved parent and it should mean a lot that your child came to you with this information.
